name: mode-toggle
description: A source-owned Light/Dark/System theme toggle for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Composes the installed dropdown-menu registry item with adico_primitives::theme_mode for Light/Dark/System selection. Persists the selection (localStorage on web, a preferences file on desktop) and applies the resolved appearance's class to the document root automatically. Classified `EXISTING_SHADCN_EQUIVALENT`-adjacent -- shadcn's theming docs ship an equivalent Light/Dark/System dropdown pattern; see statics/component_compatibility.json and design.md §7b.
documentation.accessibility: Composes the installed `DropdownMenuTrigger` (a `Button`) and `theme_mode`'s `ThemeMode`/`ResolvedTheme` resolution (`packages/adico-primitives/src/theme_mode.rs`); its own accessibility surface is entirely the composed `DropdownMenu`'s (`role="menu"`/`role="menuitem"`).
documentation.keyboard: Same as `DropdownMenu`: arrow keys navigate the light/dark/system options, Enter/Space selects one.
